Title: Verify that a customer can click a Dynamic payment link and complete a guest checkout card payment successfully

Step Action: Click the merchant's payment link
Step Expected: A browser-based payment interface opens

Step Action: Observe the amount field
Step Expected: The amount field is blank and editable

Step Action: Enter a valid payment amount and an optional note
Step Expected: Values are accepted; the Payee cannot be changed

Step Action: Select/tap the merchant name to open the merchant info modal
Step Expected: Modal opens showing "Powered by" and Business Name, Business Email, Contact Number, Business Address

Step Action: Close the modal and select "Checkout as guest" (or equivalent guest option)
Enter a valid full name (e.g. "Naomi Silvera") and a valid email address
Step Expected: Values are accepted

Step Action: Enter valid card details: cardholder name, a valid card number, a valid future expiry date (MM/YYYY), and a valid CVV for the card brand
Tap "Make payment"
Step Expected: The customer is redirected to the card issuer's authentication page

Step Action: Complete the 3DS challenge successfully
Step Expected: The issuer returns approval and payment processing continues

Step Action: Observe the result screen
Step Expected: Payment success confirmation is shown, with the merchant name and amount displayed

Title: Verify that a customer can click a Static payment link and complete a payment with the merchant's pre-set amount

Step Action: Click the merchant's Static payment link
Step Expected: A browser-based payment interface opens

Step Action: Observe the amount field
Step Expected: The amount is pre-filled with the merchant's set amount and is NOT editable

Step Action: Proceed to guest checkout and card entry with valid data
Step Expected: Values are accepted

Step Action: Tap "Make payment" and complete the 3DS challenge if presented
Step Expected: Payment is processed

Step Action: Observe the result screen
Step Expected: Payment success is displayed with the correct, unmodified fixed amount

Step Action: Select "Pay with GK One App"
Step Expected: The GK One app opens directly

Title: Verify that the customer is redirected to the app store when selecting "Pay with GK One App" and GK One is not installed

Step Expected: The custom field (e.g. "Unit Number") is displayed alongside name and email

Step Action: Enter a valid value in the custom field, along with a valid name and email
Step Expected: Values are accepted

Step Action: Proceed to card entry and complete the payment with valid details

Step Expected: Value is accepted, no validation error shown

Step Action: Complete the remaining card fields with valid data and submit payment
Step Expected: Payment proceeds

Title: Verify that a customer can add an optional note when entering a Dynamic payment amount via a payment link

Step Action: Enter a valid amount and a short note (e.g. "Invoice #4521")
Step Expected: Note is accepted

Step Action: Proceed through checkout and complete the payment
Step Expected: Payment is processed successfully with the note attached

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment when a Dynamic payment amount entered via a link is below $1000

Step Action: Enter an amount of $999.99
Attempt to continue
Step Expected: A validation message is displayed; the customer cannot proceed

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment when a Dynamic payment amount entered via a link is above $350,000

Step Action: Enter an amount of $350,000.01
Attempt to continue
Step Expected: A validation message is displayed; the customer cannot proceed

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment when the Dynamic amount field is left empty

Step Action: Leave the amount field empty
Attempt to continue
Step Expected: An error is displayed indicating an amount is required; the customer cannot proceed

Title: Verify that the system blocks guest checkout via a payment link when required fields (name or email) are left blank

Step Action: Leave the name field blank, enter a valid email
Attempt to continue
Step Expected: A validation message is displayed for the missing name field; customer cannot proceed

Step Action: Enter a valid name, leave the email field blank
Attempt to continue
Step Expected: A validation message is displayed for the missing email field; customer cannot proceed

Title: Verify that the system blocks guest checkout via a payment link when the email address is in an invalid format

Step Action: Enter a valid name and an incorrectly formatted email address (e.g. "naomi@@gmail")
Attempt to continue
Step Expected: A validation message is displayed indicating the email format is invalid; customer cannot proceed

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment submission when the cardholder name field is left empty, via a payment link

Step Action: Leave the cardholder name field empty, complete all other card fields with valid data
Tap "Make payment"
Step Expected: An error is displayed; payment is blocked

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment submission when the cardholder name does not contain a space (single-word entry), via a payment link

Step Action: Enter "NaomiSilvera" (no space) as the cardholder name, complete all other card fields with valid data
Tap "Make payment"
Step Expected: An error is displayed indicating a full name (first and last) is required; payment is blocked

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment submission when an invalid card number is entered, via a payment link

Step Action: Enter an invalid/non-existent card number, complete all other card fields with valid data
Tap "Make payment"
Step Expected: An appropriate error is displayed; payment is blocked

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment submission when the card's expiry date has already passed, via a payment link

Step Action: Enter an expiry date that has already passed, complete all other card fields with valid data
Tap "Make payment"
Step Expected: An error is displayed indicating the card is expired; payment is blocked

Title: Verify that the system rejects an expiry date with a month value greater than 12, via a payment link

Step Action: Enter "13/2027" in the expiry date field, complete all other card fields with valid data
Tap "Make payment"
Step Expected: A validation error is displayed; payment is blocked

Title: Verify that the system rejects non-numeric or malformed input in the expiry date field, via a payment link

Step Action: Enter non-numeric characters (e.g. "AB/CDEF") in the expiry date field
Step Expected: Input is rejected or a validation error is shown

Step Action: Enter a malformed value (e.g. "1/27" or "012027") in the expiry date field
Step Expected: Input is rejected or a validation error is shown

Step Action: Attempt to submit payment with the malformed value still present
Step Expected: Payment is blocked

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment when the CVV length does not match the card brand (Visa/Mastercard), via a payment link

Step Action: Enter a 2-digit CVV, then a 4-digit CVV
Tap "Make payment" for each case
Step Expected: An error is displayed for each; payment is blocked (Visa/Mastercard requires exactly 3 digits)

Title: Verify that the system blocks payment when the CVV length does not match the card brand (Amex), via a payment link

Step Action: Enter a 3-digit CVV
Tap "Make payment"
Step Expected: An error is displayed; payment is blocked (Amex requires exactly 4 digits)

Title: Verify that payment is declined when 3D Secure authentication fails, via a payment link

Step Action: Enter valid card details and tap "Make payment"
Step Expected: The customer is redirected to the issuer's authentication page

Step Action: Complete the authentication challenge with details that cause it to fail
Step Expected: The issuer returns a failed outcome

Step Action: Observe the result screen
Step Expected: Payment is declined; no payment success confirmation is shown

Title: Verify that payment is not processed when a customer exits the 3D Secure authentication flow before completing it, via a payment link

Step Action: Enter valid card details and tap "Make payment"
Step Expected: The customer is redirected to the issuer's authentication page

Step Action: Exit/abandon the authentication flow before completing it (e.g. close the challenge, navigate back)
Step Expected: The customer is returned to the payment link checkout without a completed authentication outcome

Step Action: Observe the result screen
Step Expected: No payment success confirmation is shown; payment has not been processed

Title: Verify that a Dynamic payment amount of exactly $350,000 is accepted (upper boundary)
